summary: STAK Inc., a Cayman-incorporated China-based oil and gas equipment issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing results of its Class A meeting and extraordinary general meeting held 9 October 2026, together with a Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association adopted by special resolution. The charter changes take effect upon a Change of Voting Rights, Share Capital Reduction and Reorganization, and Share Capital Increase, authorizing dual-class capital of 750 billion class A and 250 billion class B shares at USD0.0000001 par. No price, stake, or transaction terms are stated; watch implementation mechanics of the capital reorganization and voting-right shift.
